title.it: Risoluzione ricorsione infinita nella sintesi vocale assistente Windows
title.en: Fix infinite recursion in Windows assistant voice synthesis
title.fr: Correction récursion infinie synthèse vocale assistant Windows
title.es: Corrección de recursión infinita en síntesis vocal asistente Windows

fixes.it: Corretta la chiamata a self.ear.send in Voice._send per evitare l'errore maximum recursion depth exceeded durante l'avvio della risposta vocale dell'assistente Windows.
fixes.en: Fixed call to self.ear.send in Voice._send preventing maximum recursion depth exceeded errors during Windows assistant voice playback.
fixes.fr: Correction de l'appel self.ear.send dans Voice._send évitant l'erreur maximum recursion depth exceeded lors de la réponse vocale Windows.
fixes.es: Corregida la llamada a self.ear.send en Voice._send evitando el error maximum recursion depth exceeded durante la respuesta de voz de Windows.
